from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/ec20/Proofs')
R = Path('Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC')
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
maps = [
    Path('/tmp/zfc-routing245-complete-coverage-publication/map.json'),
    Path('/tmp/zfc-routing245-binary-publication/map.json'),
    Path('/tmp/zfc-ax-next-imp254-publication/map.json'),
]
expected = {}
for m in maps:
    d = json.loads(m.read_text())
    for row in d['files']:
        if row['target'] in expected:
            assert expected[row['target']] == row['sha256']
        expected[row['target']] = row['sha256']

doc_review = json.loads(Path('/tmp/zfc-routing245-final-doc-review/final-document-review.json').read_text())
for row in doc_review['documents']:
    p = Path(row['path'])
    assert sha(p.read_bytes()) == row['sha256']
    expected[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] = row['sha256']

supplements = [
    'pa_internalization.md',
    'results/arithmetic-control-ax-next-imp254-maintained-preparation.json',
    'results/arithmetic-control-ax-next-imp254-installed-review.json',
    'results/routing245-binary-maintained-preparation.json',
    'results/routing245-binary-installed-review.json',
    'results/routing245-coverage-installation-review.json',
    'results/routing245-publication-doc-review.json',
    'results/upstream-internal-interpretation-ec37dd933a-review.json',
    'results/routing245-pa-plan-source-review.json',
]
for s in supplements:
    p = R / s
    expected[str(p)] = sha((ROOT / p).read_bytes())

staged = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z'], cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\0')[:-1]
assert set(staged) <= expected.keys(), sorted(set(staged) - expected.keys())
proc = subprocess.Popen(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
total = 0
for p, h in sorted(expected.items()):
    assert sha((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) == h, p
    proc.stdin.write((':' + p + '\n').encode()); proc.stdin.flush()
    header = proc.stdout.readline().decode().strip().split()
    assert len(header) == 3 and header[1] == 'blob', (p, header)
    size = int(header[2]); data = proc.stdout.read(size)
    assert proc.stdout.read(1) == b'\n'
    assert len(data) == size and sha(data) == h, p
    total += size
proc.stdin.close()
assert proc.wait() == 0

installation = json.loads((ROOT / R / 'results/routing245-coverage-installation-review.json').read_text())
excluded = installation['whitespace_check']['preserved_archived_diff_files']
for p, aliases in excluded.items():
    assert p in expected
    data = (ROOT / p).read_bytes()
    for alias in aliases:
        assert alias.endswith('.diff') and Path(alias).read_bytes() == data
cmd = ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check', '--', '.', *[':(exclude)' + p for p in excluded]]
check = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert check.returncode == 0, check.stdout + check.stderr

out = Path('/tmp/zfc-routing245-binary-publication/root-final-index-review.json')
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps({
    'status': 'FINAL_ROUTING245_AND_NEXT_IMP_PUBLICATION_INDEX_PASS',
    'maps': [{'path': str(m), 'sha256': sha(m.read_bytes())} for m in maps],
    'mapped_and_supplemental_files': len(expected), 'staged_changed_files': len(staged),
    'bytes_checked_from_index': total,
    'index_hashes_match_current_and_selected_bytes': True,
    'six_documents_match_independent_final_review': True,
    'whitespace_check_exit': check.returncode,
    'excluded_exact_original_diff_blobs': excluded,
    'scope': 'Current Git index and worktree bytes only. All three publication maps plus selected documentation and supplements. No proof replay. Exact original archived diffs retain their original whitespace.',
    'findings': [],
}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'path': str(out), 'sha256': sha(out.read_bytes()), 'files': len(expected), 'staged': len(staged)}))
